title: Chapter 1279
text:
Somewhere in the Blackhole Edge Star Field, a small fleet was advancing toward the Flickering World.

In the command room of the leading ship, many operators were busy at their posts, reporting the parameters from time to time.

"Reporting, captain, we have left the Hait Civilization's territory and entered the low-security area where space pirates wreak havoc. The alert level has been adjusted to level 7. In about fifty-four hours, the fleet will arrive at the joint neutral area and enter the radiation range of the Interstellar Field Stargate."

"Hmm, expand the patrol range of the unmanned reconnaissance fleet. The next section of the road is not safe, so be careful."

Garvin sat in the captain's seat and gave orders.

He was tall and slender, with a fair complexion and a handsome appearance. He wore a black wide-brimmed hat with a white feather at the top. He wore a set of elegant and decent casual clothes with the top of the hat open, revealing his smooth and fair chest. There was a long and thin sword in a sheath hanging from his waist, engraved with magic patterns. It was obviously a magic weapon.

'White Wave' Garvin, one of the recorded Beyond Grade A seeds, did not belong to any organization and usually traveled freely in the universe.

This kind of neutral Beyond Grade A seed had always been an important target for the advanced civilizations to rope in, and Garvin was no exception. The three Universal Civilizations, the Supercluster Civilizations, and the local civilizations of the Blackhole Edge had all extended an olive branch to him.

However, Garvin had never expressed his opinion, not only because he did not like to work, but also because he wanted to wait for the right price.

Originally, the price of the three Universal Civilizations had already moved him, and he was hesitating whether to join them or not. However, the recent Sanctum Revival incident made Garvin give up on the idea.

Even though the three Universal Civilizations had greatly increased the price of roping him in after the incident, Garvin was not moved. He suddenly lost interest in the resources promised by the three Universal Civilizations and did not even have the intention to continue negotiating. He decided to turn around and join a Beyond Grade A organization, heading straight to the Flickering World with his fleet.

He had even chosen his target. Black Star had the Sanctum Revival, so he would join the Black Star Corps. If he stepped into the Beyond Grade A realm in the future, he would have the advantage of being in a favorable position.

Garvin casually swiped through the communicator, browsing the recent news on the local network channel. Soon, he saw a headline titled 'The three Universal Civilizations claim to have long known about the Sanctum Revival phenomenon, have been secretly researching it, and have recently obtained in-progress results'. He could not help but curl his lips with a disapproving expression.

"Tsk, the three Universal Civilizations have started to spread fake news to appease the people …"

Recently, similar news had been spreading. Due to the impact of the Sanctum Revival on the outside world, many social classes had a chain reaction. Even some direct members of the advanced civilizations were shaken. In Garvin to to to make a move to come to an end, to appease the people to make outsiders believe that the three Universal Civilizations to master of the Sanctum Revival.

Although the Sanctum Revival was a new technology, the three Universal to to to it to be to to to be to to to to to Be to be, to to be to, Civilization, Civilization civilization... to the Sanctum Sanctum Civilization to to To Being to Day, the to the to to to it, to be to to to be, to be found, to be, to the Civilization civilization was, Civilization civilization civilization civilization.

However, most of the people who believed in such rumors were the lower-class galactic residents. Naturally, Gavin did not believe it.

"The three Universal Civilizations are feeling the pressure. That's not a bad thing. Only when there is competition between the big factions will we get more attention. In order to win us over, they have no choice but to give us better benefits. If not for the three Universal Civilizations feeling the pressure of competition, they would not have suddenly increased the bargaining chip to win me over."

Garvin scratched his chin and muttered to himself.

After reading the news for a while, Gavin realized that there was something wrong with the netizens' comment section. It was filled with a large number of curses directed at Supers. Some were sarcastic about the privileges of Supers, while others were angry and shared cases of Supers bullying ordinary people. These comments were actually liked by a large number of passersby.

Garvin carefully browsed through it and shook his head helplessly.

Most ordinary people were envious of the strength, status, and privileges of Supers, but they were also jealous of them. Supers were one of the most active classes in the universe, but they only made up a very small portion of the total population of the universe. Ordinary people were the mainstream, and the conflict between the two had been accumulating for a long time.

Most people were destined to not have the potential to become a Super from the moment they were born and were destined to be mediocre for life. The more they envied Supers, the more they hated that they did not have such a life. They hated the unfairness of fate, so their hatred was transferred to Supers. It was difficult for reason to tame the human heart. There was always a place for the thought of not worrying about scarcity but inequality, forming a stubborn social conflict between the two classes.

On the scale of the universe, Supers and ordinary people were not just a matter of class. They were not even the same 'creatures'. Supers represented the direction of life evolution, and ordinary people represented the backward low-level life forms. Even if the galactic society did not advocate such a thought, many people believed that this was the truth.

The ordinary people who occupied the mainstream of the population were unwilling to accept their innate position of 'being eliminated in the evolution process', so conflict was destined.

In real life, most galactic residents did not dare act rashly in front of Supers, but on the quantum network, they did not have to worry. The existence of the Sanctum Revival seemed to have become an opportunity to ignite the accumulated resentment of the classes. Many ordinary people became more and more angry, cursing the injustice.

In the group of thoughts with the nature of venting, emotions were often higher than rationality. Even if many people knew that the strength of Supers was the result of hard work, it was meaningless. Either all the Supers in the universe died, or they became Supers too. Otherwise, they would still curse.

Although Kevin was not surprised by this, he felt that the class conflict this time seemed to have erupted a little too fiercely. He did not believe that there was no mastermind behind it.

"The dark clouds keep piling up, and the storm will come as expected. I feel that if this continues, the future of the galactic society will not be good …"

Kevin could not help but shake his head.

Boom!

At this time, the spaceship suddenly shook, and the radar buzzed.

"Warning! Warning! Detecting space interference device nearby. Exiting hyperdrive flight mode. Detecting an unknown spaceship approaching quickly! "

Kevin was slightly shocked. He quickly enlarged his vision and saw a small fleet surrounding them. It was a pirate gang active in this area, and the captain seemed to be a Calamity Grade.

The next moment, the voice of this pirate gang sounded in the public channel.

"Stop the ship immediately and open the connecting passage. Let our people board the ship, or we will open fire!"

"So, it's a robbery …"

Kevin heaved a sigh of relief, and his face turned cold.

"Captain, what do we do?" the pilot asked. Because he believed in Kevin's strength, he was not nervous at all.

"Humph, let them board the ship. If they want to die, let them come. I'll deal with them."

Kevin's eyes flickered.

Very soon, the fleet stopped in place according to his instructions. Seeing this, the pirate gang quickly approached, and the two sides connected.

The cabin door opened with a whoosh, and a group of space pirates stepped onto Gavin's spaceship with their guns raised. Everyone on the spaceship was waiting in front of the passage.

"Where is the captain? Come out and see me!" The pirate leader looked around the crowd.

At this time, a loud roar sounded from the crowd.

"You provoked the wrong person!"

Gavin, who had concealed his aura and was hiding in the crowd, suddenly attacked. He pulled out his slender saber and slashed out a stream of light. A sharp cold light flashed out.

The pirate leader was shocked and hurriedly raised his arm. Pugilist flames wrapped around his arm, turning into solid armor as he tried to block the sudden attack.

Swoosh!

The next second, blood flashed, and the pirate leader cried out in pain. The blade cut through his protective flames and deeply embedded into his blocking arm.

Kevin held the saber with both hands and spun around. A wave-like white saber light suddenly lit up and disappeared in a flash, leaving a stunning scar on everyone's retina.

Swoosh! One of the pirate leader's arms was chopped off. The cut was smooth, and the blood did not seem to be able to keep up with the speed of the saber light. It froze for a full second before spurting out, dyeing the corridor of the spaceship red.

Both of them were Calamity Grades, but Kevin's rank was far higher than his opponent's. With a single attack, he crippled his opponent. As a Pugilist of the Combat Soldier Branch, Kevin's lethality was extremely high. In terms of saber techniques, he had long reached the level of a grandmaster.

However, at this time, a sudden change occurred!

In the team of galactic pirates, seven or eight people suddenly burst out with the aura of a Calamity Grade and attacked Kevin at the same time. They were like hunters who had been hiding for a long time and suddenly released their killing intent!

"What!" Kevin's pupils constricted, and his expression changed drastically.

These people were definitely not members of the galactic pirates. If this galactic pirate group had so many experts, they would have long been famous. It was impossible for him not to be mentally prepared.

He was so close, yet he did not discover the aura of these people. These ambushers were definitely not simple!

Kevin did not have time to think about the origins of these people. He hurriedly dodged and blocked. However, the sneak attack was too sudden, and he did not manage to block much of the attack. He took the brunt of the attack and immediately spat out blood. As a Pugilist of the Combat Soldier Branch, he did not specialize in defense.

"They're not ordinary Calamity Grades. They're all experts!"

Gavin was horrified. While he was vomiting blood, he used the reaction force to shoot out. He slashed out a wide crescent-shaped slash and shattered the cabin wall of the spaceship. He escaped into the universe and went straight to another spaceship.

At this time, seven or eight Calamity Grade Supers immediately chased after him and surrounded him. They cooperated well, trapping Kevin while destroying all the spaceships, not leaving any behind for the other party to escape.

Seeing his escape routes being cut off one by one, Kevin's eyes were about to pop out of their sockets. He had no choice but to resist with all his might. His blade flashed back and forth, fighting with this group of people. Very soon, he was surrounded by danger.

Even as a Beyond Grade A seed, he could not take the attacks of seven or eight Calamity Grade Supers. Not everyone had the terrifying resistance of Black Star.

"You guys are not galactic pirates. Who are you?"

Kevin asked loudly in the public channel. Through the aura lock, he could vaguely feel the resolute killing intent of these Calamity Grade Supers toward him. It was as though they had been targeting him from the beginning.

Could it be that this group of galactic pirates and these people were deliberately hiding here to ambush me?

However, his question was destined not to be answered. These Calamity Grade Supers remained silent, only attacking more and more fiercely, releasing cold killing intent without restraint.

Seeing this, Kevin clenched his teeth, unwilling to sit still and wait for death. He called for help in the public channel while trying his best to break out of the encirclement. Even though he knew that his chances of survival were extremely slim, he could not give up.

Several figures were entangled in a fierce battle. Shockwaves of energy blasted out in all directions. The battlefield was constantly shifting as the battle continued.

More and more wounds appeared on Kevin's body, and he was covered in blood. He did not know how long he had been fighting, but he was gradually exhausted, and his consciousness began to blur.

"It wasn't easy for me to have the strength I have now, and I have hope of stepping into the Beyond Grade A realm. My future is bright. Am I going to die here for no reason today?"

Kevin forced himself to stay awake, and a strong sense of unwillingness surged in his mind.

However, at this moment, their attacks suddenly stopped, and they looked up at the universe not far away. A shuttle-shaped spaceship appeared in their line of sight and was approaching. It seemed to have discovered the abnormal energy reaction here and had come to check it out.

"There are witnesses. What do we do?"

"Ignore them. Kill the target first. End this quickly."

The few of them quickly communicated, and the next moment, the intensity of their attacks soared again. They abandoned all defense and switched to fighting with injuries.

This was the last straw that broke the camel's back. Gavin's heavily injured body could not withstand the sudden increase in attacks and was hit by the storm. His entire body shattered inch by inch, and his life force quickly left this shell.

Just as a Calamity Grade Supers was about to deal the final fatal blow, something unexpected happened!

Hum!

A holy golden light suddenly shot out from the shuttle-shaped spaceship that was rapidly approaching, shining on Kevin's tattered body.

The next moment, as though a miracle happened, Kevin's body recovered in the blink of an eye, and all his injuries disappeared without a trace. His eyes were wide open, as though he had not recovered from his shock.

"This is …"

The pupils of the few Calamity Grade Supers suddenly constricted, and they all looked at the spaceship that the light came from.

At the same time, inside the shuttle-shaped spaceship, Aurora retracted her hand, and her eyes flashed with excitement and curiosity.

"Going out with you is indeed very fun. We can always encounter strange things."

Hearing this, Fu Ding shook his head helplessly.

If he hadn't been pulled in as a strong man, he wouldn't have wanted to accompany Aurora on a trip. Although he was called a "bodyguard," in reality, he just wanted to ride on his luck and use him as a trigger to make the trip more interesting and exciting.
